title: The Signature Approach to Graphene-Based Microprocessors (Signature)
provenance: Signature original design work by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled original designs and improvements — original work, not presented as established public fact.
description: The Signature approach plays graphene's strengths: win RF and interconnect now with hybrid integration, solve the bandgap with atomic precision, and build toward the graphene processor. Speed first, logic follows. This is Signature original work by Justin Addam Higgins: an original design direction for Graphene-Based Microprocessors, labeled as Signature throughout, and never presented as established public fact. Signature graphene ships in radios, wires, and eventually processors: THz front-ends, invisible flexible electronics, and the first real graphene microprocessor. Carbon's second act.
